An adventurer died among many dragons in the {wiki:Edron Dragon Lair|Edron Dragon Lair}. Cross the lair, pass the level 60 door, kill 3 {creature:Dragon Lord|Dragon Lords} and 3 {creature:Dragon Lord Hatchling|Dragon Lord Hatchlings} and take a {item:Ring of Healing}, a {item:Dragon Necklace} and 7 {item:Small Diamond|Small Diamonds}. Then open the hidden hole with the Pick to reach the {item:Fire Axe}.
An adventurer died in the middle of many dragons.
or equivalent, to open the Fire Axe hole
Bring fire protection and potions: the Dragon Lords attack with fire waves and fireballs.
Bring a few {item:Destroy Field Rune|Destroy Field Runes}: there may be fire fields over the Fire Axe hole.
1. Getting to the Edron Dragon Lair

If you are not in **Edron**, take a boat (for example {npc:Captain Bluebear} in Thais: {key:hi}, {key:edron}, {key:yes}); you arrive at Edron's port, next to {npc:Captain Seahorse}. Leave {wiki:Edron Castle|Edron Castle} to the **south** and follow the road **east**, towards {wiki:Stonehome|Stonehome}.

After crossing the bridge at the exit of Edron, go **north** along the mountain until you find {wiki:Avar Tar|Avar Tar}. Climb the ramp **west** of Avar Tar to reach the mountain pass of the {wiki:Edron Wyvern Hill|Edron Wyvern Hill}.
Go through the passage and go down
Follow the mountain pass all the way **west** and go down at the end.
Do not go up: that is the Edron Wyvern Hill.
Go **north** until you come across a big hill. Turn **west** and keep going until you find another hill: that is the Edron Dragon Lair.
The entrance to the Edron Dragon Lair
On the way you may meet a {creature:Wyvern}. {creature:Orshabaal} may also appear in this area, but you are unlikely to run into him.
Go down the ramp and the first hole
Go down the ramp inside the mountain. There are 2 {creature:Dragon|Dragons} here. Go **north** and go down the hole.
There is nothing on this floor: go **north** and climb up with the {item:Rope} to reach the main area of the lair.
Go **north**, ready for many {creature:Dragon Hatchling|Dragon Hatchlings} and {creature:Dragon|Dragons}. Halfway across the floor there is a ramp going down: take it when you find it.
Lair map 1: yellow = start, green = destination
At the bottom of the ramp there is a single {creature:Dragon Lord}. Kill it and go down the hole.
To the **west** there is a level 60 {item:Gate of Expertise} and nothing else. Pass through the door and go down the hole.
Right on arrival you find 3 {creature:Dragon Lord|Dragon Lords} and 3 {creature:Dragon Lord Hatchling|Dragon Lord Hatchlings}. Kill them all.
The Dragon Lords and Dragon Lord Hatchlings in the final room
Three Dragon Lords together deal a lot of fire damage. Pull them calmly and keep your health high.
Open the chest in the **southwest corner** of the room. You receive a {item:Ring of Healing}, a {item:Dragon Necklace} and 7 {item:Small Diamond|Small Diamonds}.
The quest chest in the southwest corner
Ring of Healing, Dragon Necklace and 7 Small Diamonds

If nobody has taken them, there is another chest with 300 {item:Gold Coin|Gold Coins}, a {item:Steel Shield}, {item:Plate Legs}, a {item:Double Axe}, a {item:Dark Helmet} and a half-decomposed human {item:Skeleton (Item)|skeleton}.
Opening the hole with the Pick

For the Fire Axe you have to find the Pick hole on this floor: it is **2 sqm southwest** of where you arrived, that is, **3 sqm east and 5 sqm north** of the quest chest. Use the {item:Pick} on that tile.
Yellow = start, green = Pick hole, cyan = quest chest, red = small hole (you cannot go down it)
The spot to use the Pick
If there are fire fields on top, use a {item:Destroy Field Rune}. Note: there is also a small hole in this room that you cannot go down; it is not that one.
Go down the hole you opened and use the {item:Pile of Bones (Quest)|pile of bones} to receive the final reward.
The pile of bones with the Fire Axe

Go back the same way: climb up with the {item:Rope} through the Fire Axe hole and through the hole you came down by into the Dragon Lords' room, pass the level 60 door again and climb up through the lone Dragon Lord's hole. Climb the ramp, cross the main area to the **south** and go down where you had climbed up with the rope; head **south**, climb up through the first hole and climb the ramp until you are out of the mountain. Then return to Edron through the mountain pass and over the bridge, the way you came.
The {creature:Dragon|Dragons} and {creature:Dragon Lord|Dragon Lords} along the path may have respawned.
Also known as the *Triple DL Quest*, because of the three Dragon Lords in the final room.
